description.en: The number of entries to return on each page.

description.zh:
节目单ID。如果填此参数，则返回该节目单信息。若不填，默认返回该用户所有节目单信息。
如果您通过[AddPlaylistItems接口](~~2848078~~)添加节目单项，请查看AddPlaylistItems接口调用返回的参数ProgramId值。
description.en: The ID of the playlist. If you specify this parameter, only the information about the specified playlist is returned. If you leave this parameter empty, the information about all playlists that belong to your account is returned. Use the ProgramId value returned by the [AddPlaylistItems](~~2848078~~) operation.

descriptions.zh:
先通过[AddPlaylistItems接口](~~2848078~~)添加节目单项，再调用本接口查询节目单。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Call the [AddPlaylistItems](~~2848078~~) operation to add items to a playlist before you query it.

## QPS limits

This operation is limited to 10 queries per second (QPS) per user. API calls that exceed this limit are throttled. Throttling may affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.
